events.title: Redburn Says Its Southwest Sell Thesis Has “Played Out.” So Why Does It Still Prefer Delta and United?
events.summary: Redburn upgraded Southwest Airlines Co. to Neutral from Sell, stating its bearish thesis had "played out" due to valuation adjustments and stronger-than-expected product pivot gains. Despite this, Redburn maintains Buy ratings on Delta Air Lines Inc. and United Airlines Holdings, Inc., favoring their long-term prospects due to strong leisure/premium demand, capacity restrictions, and their international networks. The firm sees Southwest's product pivot as compelling but views its structural disadvantage in a globally focused framework as a limiting factor compared to its preferred network carriers.

articles.headline: Redburn Says Its Southwest Sell Thesis Has “Played Out.” So Why Does It Still Prefer Delta and United?

events.title: Watch Morgan Stanley’s Jonas: Physical AI Could Multiply Global GDP
events.summary: Morgan Stanley's Adam Jonas believes that the convergence of AI and robotics, termed "physical AI," could significantly boost global GDP by spreading across various sectors like transportation and manufacturing. He emphasizes the link between the robotics race and rebuilding US manufacturing, noting China's supply chain advantage. Jonas also suggests that Tesla and SpaceX could play crucial roles in a future with numerous connected robots performing AI inference.

articles.headline: Watch Morgan Stanley’s Jonas: Physical AI Could Multiply Global GDP

events.title: Marathon Oil stock joins ConocoPhillips after USD 22.5 billion deal
events.summary: Marathon Oil (US5658491064) became part of ConocoPhillips in November 2024 through a USD 22.5 billion acquisition. As of September 23, 2026, Marathon Oil is no longer a standalone listed company, with its assets and corporate identity now integrated into ConocoPhillips. The transaction, announced in May 2024, concluded six months later, marking the end of Marathon Oil's independent corporate structure.

articles.headline: Marathon Oil stock joins ConocoPhillips after USD 22.5 billion deal

events.title: Brookfield Renewable Partners' 4.51% yield is appealing—yet the real test is whether its growing clean energy portfolio can keep income investors confident for years to come.
events.summary: Brookfield Renewable Partners (TSX:BEP:UN) offers an appealing 4.51% dividend yield and a diversified clean energy portfolio, making it attractive to income-oriented investors. The partnership benefits from long-term contracts, geographic diversification, and disciplined capital allocation, supporting its dividend sustainability and long-term growth. While risks like rising interest rates and project execution exist, Brookfield Renewable's strong market position and structural industry tailwinds provide a constructive long-term outlook for investors seeking recurring income and exposure to the clean energy transition.

articles.headline: Brookfield Renewable Partners' 4.51% yield is appealing—yet the real test is whether its growing clean energy portfolio can keep income investors confident for years to come.

events.title: EQT Corporation stock gains 0.72 percent on gas outlook
events.summary: EQT Corporation's stock rose by 0.72 percent following a new production outlook that forecasts higher natural gas output in 2026 with reduced spending. This strategy aims to improve cash generation, despite a significant 29.2 percent year-over-year revenue drop in the second quarter. Analysts maintain an "Overweight" rating with a price target considerably above the current trading price.

articles.headline: EQT Corporation stock gains 0.72 percent on gas outlook

events.title: MarketAxess stock trades 1.9 percent below ICE offer
events.summary: MarketAxess stock is trading 1.9% below Intercontinental Exchange's (ICE) proposed cash offer of $167.00 per share, with the stock at $163.76 on September 23, 2026. Shareholders are set to vote on the acquisition on October 29, 2026, which would make MarketAxess a wholly owned subsidiary of ICE. This occurs as MarketAxess reported a slight 0.5% decrease in Q2 2026 revenue, though diluted EPS remained consistent year-over-year.

articles.headline: MarketAxess stock trades 1.9 percent below ICE offer

events.title: Arcosa stock stays below the USD 150 acquisition offer
events.summary: Arcosa stock traded at $146.75 on September 23, 2026, remaining 2.17% below the $150-per-share acquisition offer, even after shareholders approved the all-cash deal. The acquisition is expected to close in Q1 2027. Additionally, Arcosa reported Q3 revenue of $658.7 million, missing the consensus estimate of $687.5 million, and adjusted EPS of $1.13, which was below the $1.18 consensus.

articles.headline: Arcosa stock stays below the USD 150 acquisition offer

events.title: Gold Defied the Fed’s Rate Hike—These 3 Plays Stand Out
events.summary: Gold, typically inversely correlated with interest rates, briefly dipped after the Fed's latest rate hike but quickly recovered, suggesting that factors like central bank buying and counterparty risk now override traditional rate sensitivity. Central banks, particularly China, are actively accumulating and repatriating gold to hedge against geopolitical risks and rising U.S. debt, rather than merely diversifying from the dollar. For investors seeking exposure to this trend, Newmont Corp. (NEM) offers a direct play on gold mining, Wheaton Precious Metals (WPM) provides a lower-risk royalty model, and iShares Silver Trust (SLV) taps into silver's independent supply deficit story.

articles.headline: Gold Defied the Fed’s Rate Hike—These 3 Plays Stand Out

events.title: Rollins stock falls 44.3 percent as earnings miss weighs
events.summary: Rollins Inc. stock has fallen 44.3 percent year-to-date, trading at USD 32.86 on September 23, 2026, due to an earnings miss in the second quarter. The company reported EPS of USD 0.32, below the USD 0.34 estimate, and revenue of USD 1.08 billion, slightly missing the USD 1.09 billion estimate. This performance has led to significant price target cuts from analysts, and the stock is trading near its 52-week low.

articles.headline: Rollins stock falls 44.3 percent as earnings miss weighs

events.title: Fox Corporation stock holds at USD 64.25 after earnings beat
events.summary: Fox Corporation's stock maintained its price at USD 64.25 after reporting earnings that surpassed expectations for the quarter ending June 30, 2026. The company's EPS of USD 1.79 and revenue of USD 4.21 billion exceeded analyst estimates, leading Guggenheim to reiterate an USD 85 target. Despite strong financial performance and trading above moving averages, the stock remains below its 52-week high, indicating a varied valuation perspective among analysts.

articles.headline: Fox Corporation stock holds at USD 64.25 after earnings beat

events.title: Wheaton Precious Metals Corp Stock (WPM) Moved Down by 5.08% on Sep 23: Facts Behind the Movement
events.summary: Wheaton Precious Metals Corp (WPM) stock declined by 5.08% on September 23rd due to a broader selloff in the precious metals sector, driven by hawkish monetary policy expectations and a strengthening U.S. dollar. This movement caused spot prices for gold and silver to retreat, impacting streaming revenues for companies like WPM. Despite solid long-term fundamentals, short-term momentum was affected by macroeconomic headwinds, with technical indicators showing neutral MACD and RSI, and an oversold Williams %R.

articles.headline: Wheaton Precious Metals Corp Stock (WPM) Moved Down by 5.08% on Sep 23: Facts Behind the Movement

events.title: Prediction: This Magnificent Seven Stock Could Soar 50% by 2027
events.summary: This article predicts that Alphabet (GOOG) stock could soar 50% by 2027, reaching $525 per share, driven by its rapidly growing Google Cloud business, the scaling of Gemini, and strong analyst sentiment. Despite increased capital expenditure and debt, the company's significant cloud backlog and AI-related revenue ramps are expected to propel its growth. The analysis outlines the financial math and key catalysts supporting this optimistic forecast.

articles.headline: Prediction: This Magnificent Seven Stock Could Soar 50% by 2027

events.title: Prudential Financial stock reflects a Q2 earnings beat
events.summary: Prudential Financial (PRU) reported adjusted Q2 2026 EPS of $4.08, surpassing the consensus estimate of $3.52, despite revenue of $14.15 billion falling short of the $14.36 billion estimate. The stock was trading up 0.71% at $118.50 on September 23, 2026, and its market capitalization stood at $41.1195 billion. Institutional ownership saw State Street increase its position by 1.2% during the quarter.

articles.headline: Prudential Financial stock reflects a Q2 earnings beat

events.title: Texas Instruments stock gains 1.68 percent as earnings beat estimates
events.summary: Texas Instruments' stock rose by 1.68% after reporting stronger-than-expected Q2 earnings and revenue. The company's Q2 revenue reached $5.46 billion, a 22.8% increase year-over-year, and earnings per share of $2.14 surpassed the consensus estimate. Despite varying analyst targets following the earnings beat, the stock remains below its yearly high, with future performance tied to upcoming earnings reports.

articles.headline: Texas Instruments stock gains 1.68 percent as earnings beat estimates

events.title: Duke Energy outperforms Southern Company in yie...
events.summary: Duke Energy is presented as a stronger investment than Southern Company for retirement investors, offering a higher dividend yield (3.62% vs. 3.49%), better dividend coverage, and more aggressive dividend growth. Duke's $103 billion capital plan targets nearly 10% earnings growth through 2030, supported by favorable regulatory conditions and cleaner financials. Although both companies serve regulated Southern markets and benefit from rising data center demand, Southern faces financial headwinds and slower dividend growth, making Duke a more attractive option for income-focused portfolios.

articles.headline: Duke Energy outperforms Southern Company in yie...

events.title: Kenvue stock rises as Kimberly Clark advances its takeover bid
events.summary: Kenvue stock saw a 1.10 percent increase following progress in Kimberly Clark's proposed $40 billion takeover bid, with concessions offered to address EU antitrust concerns. The European Commission has set a provisional October 13 deadline for its decision. Kenvue's Q2 FY26 revenue was reported at $3.96 billion and earnings at $456 million, with the stock closing at $17.86, still below analyst target estimates.

articles.headline: Kenvue stock rises as Kimberly Clark advances its takeover bid

events.title: PPG to close Alabama plant months after Ozark acquisition
events.summary: PPG is set to close its Alabama plant, an action that follows its acquisition of Ozark Materials LLC. The closure comes months after the acquisition, impacting the plant that produces the ThermoAccel thermoplastic lane marking product.

articles.headline: PPG to close Alabama plant months after Ozark acquisition

events.title: ADM vs. CTVA: Two Agricultural Leaders With Very Different Moats
events.summary: This article compares Archer-Daniels-Midland (ADM) and Corteva (CTVA), two agricultural leaders with distinct business models. ADM focuses on infrastructure, processing, and distribution, while CTVA leverages technology in seeds and crop protection. The analysis concludes that ADM is a relatively better investment due to its diversified platform, improving performance, stronger recent price momentum, and attractive valuation.

articles.headline: ADM vs. CTVA: Two Agricultural Leaders With Very Different Moats

events.title: Emerson Electric stock gains 1.74 percent after earnings beat
events.summary: Emerson Electric (EMR) stock rose 1.74% after its fiscal Q2 earnings per share (EPS) beat consensus estimates by $0.03, reaching $1.71. Revenue also exceeded expectations at $4.87 billion, surpassing the $4.80 billion consensus. The company provided fiscal 2026 EPS guidance of $6.55, and the stock closed at $154.36, below its 52-week high but within its trading range.

articles.headline: Emerson Electric stock gains 1.74 percent after earnings beat
